message:
0.2.0.3: authorize Xvfb capture and finalize video before display shutdown

All four profiles passed rehearsal 40661718441. Its release verified the template, JAR, 15 screenshots and manifest, but ffmpeg could not open Xvfb because the parent process lacked its authorization cookie. Pass the server-specific -auth file through XAUTHORITY. Stop the recorder on the final play marker while the title/display remains alive; make shutdown idempotent and write a fast-start MP4.

Measured CI sizes: world ZIP 402,021 bytes; injected player JAR 1,347,073 bytes. The existing 2 MiB budget remains sufficient. All profiles use the same dependency-cache key; sibling rehearsal branches still start cold under GitHub cache scope restrictions.

96 Python tests, story validation, contract text check and javacheck (133 sources) pass.
